explanation: Parameterize counterclockwise by r(t)=(2cos(t),3sin(t)). Wherever the field is defined, F(r(t))·r'(t)=-2-3=-5, giving the convergent improper integral -10π. However, F is undefined at the ellipse's four axis intersections, so ordinary circulation is not defined as stated. Option c is valid if circulation is interpreted as this improper integral.
